Robust Multimodal Driver Drowsiness Prediction System
Developed an AI-based driver drowsiness prediction system using Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, and YOLO.
Implemented eye-blink detection, yawning analysis, head pose estimation, and Kalman Filter-based tracking to
monitor driver fatigue. Improved prediction accuracy and reduced false alerts through temporal behavioral
analysis and robust multi-frame tracking.
Technologies: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, YOLO, NumPy, Kalman Filter, Deep Learning.
AI-Powered Interview Preparation Platform
 Developed a comprehensive AI-driven interview preparation platform that analyzes resumes, generates
personalized interview questions, and conducts real-time mock interviews. The system leverages NLP, computer
vision, and speech analysis to provide ATS scoring, grammar correction, eye-contact tracking, emotion detection,
communication evaluation, and AI-powered feedback. It delivers personalized career roadmaps, coding interview
assessments, and job-matching insights through an interactive analytics dashboard, helping users improve
interview readiness and professional skills.
